name: Aave Savings GHO
oneLiner: sGHO is Aave's savings wrapper of GHO; deposit GHO to earn the Aave governance-set savings rate in GHO, with GHO-tier CDP risk underneath.

mintAuthority.summary: sGHO is a savings wrapper over GHO; wrapper minting is share accounting while durable GHO mint authority is inherited from reviewed Aave facilitator controls.

controls.label: sGHO savings wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295167: asset() on the actual sGHO contract (0xe1753f2e00940cc31213dd92013cf019dfe4ca1d) returned GHO 0x40D16FC0246aD3160Ccc09B8D0D3A2cD28aE6C2f. Prior entry at 0x1a88df... was incorrect (that address is a separate contract and asset() reverts there). Wrapper is savings/share accounting only; parent GHO has reviewed facilitator-bucket mintAuthority.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295167: asset() on 0xe1753f2e00940cc31213dd92013cf019dfe4ca1d returned GHO 0x40D16FC0246aD3160Ccc09B8D0D3A2cD28aE6C2f. Prior blocker resolved: the asset() revert was on a stale/wrong address (0x1a88df...); the actual sGHO token matches the contracts[] entry. Wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting; durable mint authority inherits from reviewed parent GHO.

collateral: GHO deposited into Aave's ERC-4626 sGHO savings vault on Ethereum; share value accrues a governance-set fixed APR with no cooldown, no slashing, and no rehypothecation of deposited funds.
pegMechanism: Deposit GHO into the ERC-4626 sGHO vault to mint sGHO shares; the share-to-GHO exchange rate rises as the Aave-governance-set savings rate accrues. The vault's `asset()` is GHO and standard ERC-4626 `convertToAssets()` / `totalAssets()` reads expose NAV per share. Pharos prices this entry from the vault's share exchange rate rather than secondary-market liquidity.

oracleRisk.summary: sGHO uses internal savings-token accounting but inherits GHO collateral-oracle risk from Aave reserve oracle contracts.
